claims.text: The resort sits at the top of the cliffs of Falésia on the Algarve coast, with views over the Atlantic Ocean.

findings.quote: Located at the top of the cliffs of Falésia in the Algarve's coast, the resort's iconic location offers a unique setting with breathtaking views over the Atlantic Ocean.

claims.text: Pine Cliffs Hotel is at the heart of Pine Cliffs Resort, a five-minute walk from the beach.

findings.quote: At the heart of Pine Cliffs Resort, Pine Cliffs Hotel
placing guests just a five-minute walk from the beach

claims.text: The hotel's architecture is inspired by the region's heritage and has Moorish influences.

findings.quote: With distinctive architecture inspired by the region’s rich heritage and elegant Moorish influences

claims.text: Bed headboards, bathrooms, internal courtyards and fountains are decorated with local Portuguese tiles in a blue, white and yellow color scheme.

findings.quote: strongly informed by local Portuguese tiles, which makes for a very pretty blue, white, and yellow color scheme
Headboards for every bed are decorated in these tiles, as are bathrooms, internal courtyards, and fountains.

claims.text: Rooms and suites look out over the Albufeira coast, the Atlantic Ocean or the gardens.

findings.quote: offers breathtaking views of the Albufeira coast, the Atlantic Ocean, or our exquisite gardens

claims.text: Rooms have authentic terracotta-tiled floors.

findings.quote: Our luxury hotel rooms in Albufeira feature authentic terracotta-tiled floors

claims.text: The Pine Cliffs Golf Course is a 9-hole course designed by Martin Hawtree, perched above the Atlantic.

findings.quote: An impeccably maintained, superb 9-hole course perched 200 feet above the crystal-clear waters of the Atlantic. Designed by architect Martin Hawtree

claims.text: The Serenity Spa's thermal oasis includes an indoor hydro pool, herbal sauna, salt sauna, ice fountain and experience showers.

findings.quote: The luxurious thermal oasis at Serenity Spa
Enjoy our indoor hydro pool, herbal sauna, salt sauna, ice fountain, experience showers and many other treatments.

claims.text: Outdoor pools are set among the hotel gardens, and the main pool has cliff-top views along the coast.

findings.quote: outdoor swimming pools nestled amongst the hotel gardens
The main pool offers breathtaking cliff-top views following the beautiful Algarvian coast.

claims.text: The Annabel Croft Tennis Academy has floodlit clay and all-weather hard courts on the hotel grounds.

findings.quote: The Annabel Croft Tennis Academy features five floodlit courts—two clay and three all-weather hard courts—ideal for day or nighttime play. Located on the beautifully landscaped grounds of the Pine Cliffs Hotel

claims.text: The Porto Pirata kids' club has life-size pirate ships, a children's pool and an 18-hole mini-golf course.

findings.quote: Explore our Porto Pirata kids' club with life-size pirate ships at Pine Cliffs. Supervised fun with bouncing castle, basketball court, mini track for big-wheel toys, trampoline, a swimming pool just for kids, and an 18-hole mini-golf course

claims.text: Maré is a beach restaurant steps from the ocean, serving freshly caught fish and seafood.

findings.quote: Steps from the ocean, Maré is a contemporary beach restaurant where the flavours of the Atlantic take centre stage, with freshly caught fish and seafood

claims.text: The resort sits on top of the Falésia cliffs on the Algarve coast, looking out over the Atlantic Ocean.

findings.quote: Located at the top of the cliffs of Falésia in the Algarve's coast, the resort's iconic location offers a unique setting with breathtaking views over the Atlantic Ocean.

claims.text: The hotel is traditionally styled, with Portuguese history told through murals and hand-painted tiles.

findings.quote: traditionally styled with indigenous design, where Portuguese history is narrated through murals and hand painted tiles

claims.text: The golf course's signature Par 3 sixth hole, the Devil's Parlour, calls for a carrying shot over the cliffs above a ravine.

findings.quote: the real highlight is the Par 3 sixth hole, known as the Devil’s Parlour. This thrilling hole features a 197-metre carrying shot over the cliffs, overlooking a ravine.

claims.text: The Serenity Spa's signature treatment uses Algarve ingredients such as fleur-de-sel from Ria Formosa, sand from Falésia Beach, carob and orange oil.

findings.quote: Discover our Signature Treatment with the most traditional ingredients of the Algarve, like fleur-de-sel from Ria Formosa, sand from Falésia Beach, carob and orange oil.

claims.text: Mirador Champagne Bar sits at the very edge of the cliffs, serving champagne and cocktails.

findings.quote: toasted with exceptional champagne drinks and cocktails at the breathtaking Mirador Champagne Bar just at the edge of the cliffs

claims.text: The resort is large, and Condé Nast Traveler says its size can take some getting used to.

findings.quote: probably bigger than any hotel you’ll have been to before
The size can take some getting used to

claims.text: Restaurants and bars are subject to seasonal opening.

findings.quote: Restaurants and bars are subject to seasonal opening

claims.text: Access to the spa's thermal oasis is not complimentary.

findings.quote: Access to this area is not complimentary.
